title: Thutmose I
summary: King listed in CFAH-8 Table 14 (Egypt Dynasty 18).
description: Ruler of Egypt Dynasty 18. Person record added by the CFAH pass from the per-king rows of the OSF preprint CFAH-8 (Table 14, "CFAH-Corrected Reigns for Dynasty 18"); its dates are display only.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year.

standby.note: Standby placement only. Chronological Framework of Ancient History prints this BC/AD year on the reign entry (Start: 1035; End: 1015). It is not a sort year. No Anno Mundi, regnal length, or Julian Period figure was converted to obtain it.

reign.citation: Griffith & White, "CFAH-16: The Kings of Israel and Judah," OSF preprint v1.3 (5 May 2026), doi:10.17605/OSF.IO/YV29C, file CFAH-16_ The Kings of Israel and Judah_v1.3.pdf, Table 1 "Chronology of Neighboring Kings to Israel in the 11th Century", p. 5
reign.note: Row "Thutmose I (Egypt)" of Table 1 (Neighbours of Israel (11th century BC)).

reign.citation: Griffith & White, "CFAH-8: Placing Dynasties 15-18," OSF preprint v1.2 (29 Apr 2026), doi:10.17605/OSF.IO/Z5RTD, file CFAH-8_v1.2.pdf, Table 14 "CFAH-Corrected Reigns for Dynasty 18", pp. 101–102
